document.title: UI: navigation works without View Transitions, and Enter opens citations
document.summary: Six small UI fixes from a web-guidance audit: navigation, citations, mobile sheet, tab title, theme, and scroll.
document.why: [PR #203](source:s1) says clicking a group or opening a file did nothing on Firefox ESR 140 and Safari 17.

sources.label: PR #203
sources.gist: Audit fixes a council kept as small and safe.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Nov 12
sources.gist: Modern-web-guidance audit of src/ui and council triage.

lookFor: The [audit](source:s2) asked to render in-review citations as `HashLink` and URL citations as `<a>`. `SourceCite` keeps the `<span>` and adds an Enter handler, because citations sit inside group links and a nested link is invalid, as [PR #203](source:s1) says.
The [audit](source:s2) proposed the title `<view> · <review title> | Comprehende`. `pageTitle` leaves out `| Comprehende`, and no source gives a reason.

parts.name: Citations

parts.summary: Focus returns to Groups when the sheet closes.

groups.title: Guard the View Transition API
groups.summary: `runViewTransition` in `motion.ts` calls `update()` directly when `viewTransitionStart` finds no `startViewTransition`, and the tests in `motion.test.ts` pin that.

notes.body: The `Partial<Pick>` type makes an unguarded `.bind` call a type error.

fileNotes.src/ui/lib/motion.test.ts: Missing-API test threw on base; adds a reduced-motion case.

groups.title: Enter opens a citation
groups.summary: `SourceCite` builds one `cite` action that both click and Enter run, and drops `role="link"` when there is no action.

attention.note: A citation with no action keeps `tabIndex={0}`, so focus still opens its tooltip with the source details. Its click and Enter still call `preventDefault` and `stopPropagation`, so inside a group link they do not follow that link. Both reviewers flagged this as a nit; the PR keeps it to match the click path on `main`.

groups.title: Groups button is the sheet trigger
groups.summary: `MobileShell` wraps the layout in `Sheet` and makes the Groups button a `SheetTrigger`, so Radix sets its ARIA attributes and returns focus to it on close.

attention.note: After the user picks a group in the sheet, `pick` closes it and Radix puts focus back on Groups, not on the new group's content. A keyboard user then tabs through the header again to reach the group. The audit's moves of focus to the new view were deferred.

groups.title: Tab title names the view
groups.summary: An effect in `App.tsx` sets `document.title` from `pageTitle` in `selection.ts` whenever `meta` or `selection` changes.

fileNotes.src/ui/App.tsx: New effect beside the hash write; it writes no history.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/selection.ts: `selectionNavLabel` now takes `null`, which reads as Overview.
fileNotes.src/ui/lib/selection.test.ts: Pins `Overview · …` for `null` and `02 Show the resolved range · …`.

groups.title: Theme applies without storage
groups.summary: The head script in `index.html` reads only `localStorage` inside `try`, so the system theme applies when storage throws; before, the whole theme step was skipped.

groups.title: Comment scroll respects reduced motion
groups.summary: The scroll to `focusCommentId` in `Group.tsx` uses `instant` when `prefersReducedMotion()` is true, as `useClaimFocus` already does.

commits.subject: UI: ignore Enter repeats on citations; let the nav label take no selection
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: UI: make citations, the mobile sheet, the theme and the tab title work for everyone
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
- Citations activate on Enter; a citation with no target is no longer announced as a link.
- The mobile Groups button is the sheet trigger, so focus returns to it when the sheet closes.
- The head script applies the system theme when storage is blocked.
- The tab title names the view and the review.
- The comment scroll respects reduced motion.

commits.subject: UI: run the update directly where View Transitions are missing
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
document.startViewTransition.bind threw on Firefox before 144 and Safari before 18, so group and Inspector navigation did nothing there. Type the method as optional so an unguarded call is a type error.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
